instruction: Configure Prometheus remote write endpoint
output: echo 'remote_write: - url: https://thanos.example.com/api/v1/receive basic_auth: username: prom password_file: /etc/prometheus/pass' >> prometheus.yml

instruction: Configure Prometheus remote read endpoint
output: echo 'remote_read: - url: https://thanos.example.com/api/v1/read read_recent: true' >> prometheus.yml

instruction: Add queue config for remote write
output: echo 'remote_write: - url: http://remote:8080/write queue_config: capacity: 5000 max_shards: 200 min_shards: 10' >> prometheus.yml

instruction: Add retry config for remote write
output: echo 'remote_write: - url: http://remote:8080/write queue_config: max_retries: 5 min_backoff: 100ms max_backoff: 5s' >> prometheus.yml

instruction: Enable WAL compression for remote write
output: echo 'remote_write: - url: http://remote:8081/write write_relabel_configs: - source_labels: [__name__] regex: "expensive.*" action: drop' >> prometheus.yml

instruction: Add alerting config with Alertmanager
output: echo 'alerting: alertmanagers: - static_configs: - targets: - localhost:9093' >> prometheus.yml

instruction: Add multiple Alertmanagers with relabel
output: echo 'alerting: alertmanagers: - scheme: https tls_config: ca_file: ca.crt static_configs: - targets: - alert1:9093 - alert2:9093' >> prometheus.yml

instruction: Set alertmanager scrape interval
output: echo 'alerting: alertmanagers: - static_configs: - targets: - alertmanager:9093 scrape_interval: 30s' >> prometheus.yml
